title: India district profiles — source-backed records
description: Individually verified district facts keyed by current LGD district code. Missing records or fields remain pending; current district names are maintained separately in the LGD directory.
sourcePolicy: Each populated field must be supported by a district administration or other authoritative government source. Historical demographic figures must retain their Census reference year and boundary basis.
